## Properties

### PlayerSettings {#playersettings}

The player settings the active profile builds with: its own overrides when it has them,
and the project's otherwise.

Writing through `PlayerSettings.productName`and friends always lands on the
project's settings, which a profile that overrides them then quietly wins over. This
resolves to whichever object the build will really read.

```csharp
public PlayerSettings PlayerSettings { get; }
```

**Returns** [`PlayerSettings`](https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/PlayerSettings.html)

### SetPlayerSetting(string, string, Action) {#setplayersetting-string-string-action}

Assigns a player setting on whichever object [`PlayerSettings`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-build/VRFBuildContext#playersettings) resolved to.
Falls back to the static API if the profile could not hand one over.
